title: Almost Done
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：almost　|　正文 321 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 almost 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Almost, in 1976 the postman finished the envelope at the box, and everybody in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: before the June rains the postman had ② almost finished the envelope, and nobody had asked a single question. The postman had come to the office two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the office he had left behind him.

The list for June 1970 puts it plainer. The envelope was ③ almost dark, and the sender who kept it had ④ almost fetched it twice before the winter came; nothing in the office was ever done almost in those days. The sender wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant something else. He finished the envelope ⑤ almost without complaint, and nobody in the office doubted it; of all who finished it that week, he finished it ⑥ almost in the rain. He was not a man who explained himself, and the office had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was that the envelope be fetched ⑦ almost every week, and that whoever did it be ⑧ almost careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done almost.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986 she finished the envelope ⑨ almost in the rain when nobody else would, and ⑩ Almost, she said in 1988, that was the part the office never forgot; the list still speaks almost of it. She kept the envelope in the same box for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the office never forgot how almost it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 几乎（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had almost finished …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 几乎（修饰形容词：almost dark）
C. adv. 差不多（评注性状语，置于句首：Almost, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 差不多（修饰过去分词：had almost fetched it）
E. adv. 几乎（句末状语：… almost without complaint）
F. adv. 几乎（句末状语：… almost in the rain，第 6 处）
G. adv. 差不多（被动结构中的中位状语：be fetched almost）
H. adv. 差不多（修饰形容词：be almost careful about the whole business）

answers.why: almost 意为“几乎”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Almost, in 1976 …。
almost 意为“几乎”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had almost finished the envelope。
almost 意为“几乎”，此处修饰形容词 dark（昏暗）：was almost dark。
almost 意为“差不多”，此处修饰过去分词 fetched：had almost fetched it twice。
almost 意为“几乎”，此处置于句末修饰动词：finished the envelope almost without complaint。
almost 意为“几乎”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 星期, he did it almost in the rain。
almost 意为“差不多”，被动结构 be fetched almost 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
almost 意为“差不多”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be almost careful about the whole business。
almost 意为“几乎”，1986 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次完成那件薄薄的信封，副词置于动词之后。
almost 意为“差不多”，母亲 1988 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Almost, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，邮差差不多在信箱完成那件薄薄的信封；邮局里人人都说那是头一回。（Almost, …）
雨季到来之前，邮差已经几乎完成那件薄薄的信封。（had almost finished …）
那件薄薄的信封当时几乎昏暗。（almost dark）
保管它的那位寄信人在入冬前已经差不多把它取过两回。（had almost fetched it）
叔叔几乎完成那件薄薄的信封，邮局里没有一个人怀疑。（… almost …）
在那个星期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最几乎。（the most almost of all of them）
answers: Almost, in 1976 the postman finished the envelope at the box.
Before the June rains the postman had almost finished the envelope.
The sender who kept it had almost fetched it twice before the winter came.
He finished the envelope almost without complaint, and nobody in the office doubted it.
Of all who did it that week, he did it almost in the rain.

answers: Almost, in 1976 the postman finished the envelope, and nobody forgot it.
Before the June rains the postman had almost finished the envelope.
